ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: runesmith
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Runesmiths are engineers of magic. They etch runes into stone, steel and skin - and the runes do the rest.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Inscribe power into the world. Turrets, wards, repairs, explosive runes and gold from stone.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'Magic is just engineering with worse documentation.' — Master Runesmith Oda Varrn
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: A builder-caster with strong economy. Arcane Turrets and Explosive Runes control the field, Rune of Warding protects allies, and Transmutation pays the bills. Wants Focus and Celerity.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: golemancer
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Golemancers build their armies. Iron sentries, arc pylons and runic walls go up in seconds, and when the war comes, the Colossus wakes.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: An army of constructs. Sentries, pylons, fortress walls and the Rune Colossus.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: Twelve sentries, three pylons and a wall. The pirates left a note: 'Not worth it.'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Turret-heavy summoner and fortress builder. Drop sentries and pylons, wall the approach and keep everything repaired. Wants Focus and Resilience.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: spellforger
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Spellforgers enchant people instead of things. A spellforger's squad hits harder, shrugs off bullets, and never runs out of mana.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Enchant your allies into legends. Wards, mana and the Grand Enchantment.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'He was a farmer yesterday.' 'And today?' 'Today he's wearing six of my runes.'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: The best buffer in the game. Keep allies warded, enchanted and supplied with mana, dispel enemy magic, then drop the Grand Enchantment. Wants Focus and Attunement.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: arcane gunslinger
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Arcane Gunslingers carve runes into their bullets. Ricochets that hunt targets, armor-piercing deadeye shots, and one final bullet that kills gods.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Runic rounds and impossible shots. Magic for people who prefer guns.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'Every bullet has a name written on it. Mine have runes.'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Ranged weapon specialist. Enchant your own aim, spread runic procs with your gun, and line up Deadeye and Final Shot on the biggest targets. Wants Celerity and Attunement.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: turretmaster
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Arcane Turret conjures an additional turret.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: runeblade
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Runes on your own weapons crackle with power.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: alchemist
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Transmutation and Mend recharge much faster.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: overcharge
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every rune burns hotter. Much more damage and armor penetration.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: arcane foundry
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every construct spell builds one more construct, and they last much longer.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: grand architect
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Runes guard you even unbidden: being hit may inscribe a free Explosive Rune under the attacker.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: assembly line
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Construct spells build one more construct per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: warforged
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your constructs are built for war: half again as powerful.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: endless factory
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your constructs last twice as long and can be rebuilt far sooner.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: paragon of runes
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Allies near you are continually warded and rune-charged.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: arcane well
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You are a font of mana: allied mages near you regenerate mana from your reserves.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: sixth sense
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your shots sometimes become free ricochets.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: executioner
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: No target walks away. Gun spells crit often, finish the wounded and hit bosses hard.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: runic akimbo
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every shot you fire may be followed by a free Rune Bolt.

AbilityDef.label: rune bolt
AbilityDef.description: Fire a spinning rune that cuts through armor.

AbilityDef.label: rune of warding
AbilityDef.description: Etch a warding rune onto an ally: a strong ward and runic armor.

AbilityDef.label: arcane turret
AbilityDef.description: Conjure an arcane turret that fires rune bolts at enemies for a minute.

AbilityDef.label: explosive rune
AbilityDef.description: Inscribe a rune on the ground that detonates three seconds later.

AbilityDef.label: mend
AbilityDef.description: Runes of mending knit broken things back together: walls, turrets, weapons and armor in an area.

AbilityDef.label: enchant weapon
AbilityDef.description: Inscribe runes on an ally's weapon and nerves: faster aim, faster firing, better accuracy.

AbilityDef.label: transmutation
AbilityDef.description: Turn stone chunks in an area into silver. Every runesmith's favourite party trick.

AbilityDef.label: runic barrage
AbilityDef.description: A storm of glowing runes slams down over an area, shattering shields and armor.

AbilityDef.label: iron sentry
AbilityDef.description: Assemble a heavy runic sentry gun that fires piercing rune shells.

AbilityDef.label: arc pylon
AbilityDef.description: Raise an arc pylon that pelts enemies with chained lightning.

AbilityDef.label: fortify
AbilityDef.description: A ring of runic walls slams up around the target point.

AbilityDef.label: maintenance protocol
AbilityDef.description: Mass repair: every structure and construct in a wide area is restored.

AbilityDef.label: colossus protocol
AbilityDef.description: Wake the Rune Colossus - a towering artillery construct - alongside two iron sentries.

AbilityDef.label: empower allies
AbilityDef.description: Every ally nearby is enchanted: rune-charged weapons and empowered magic.

AbilityDef.label: runeshield array
AbilityDef.description: Project runeshields onto every ally nearby.

AbilityDef.label: disenchant
AbilityDef.description: Strip the magic from everything in an area: enemy buffs, wards and shields are destroyed.

AbilityDef.label: mana battery
AbilityDef.description: Pour your stored power into an ally mage, restoring 40% of their mana.

AbilityDef.label: grand enchantment
AbilityDef.description: Every ally in a huge radius receives every enchantment you know at once: ironhide, rune-charged weapons, empowerment, haste and a massive ward.

AbilityDef.label: quickdraw
AbilityDef.description: Rune-charge your reflexes: haste and faster, truer shooting.

AbilityDef.label: ricochet
AbilityDef.description: A runic bullet that bounces between six targets.

AbilityDef.label: deadeye
AbilityDef.description: Take aim, read the runes, and fire a single perfect shot. Massive armor-piercing damage.

AbilityDef.label: bullet storm
AbilityDef.description: Fan the hammer: a cone of runic bullets shreds everything in front of you.

AbilityDef.label: the final shot
AbilityDef.description: One bullet, inscribed with every rune you know. It ignores armor, breaks shields and tears a huge fraction of vitality from even the mightiest target.

ThingDef.label: arcane turret focus
ThingDef.description: The focusing crystal of a conjured construct.

ThingDef.label: arcane turret
ThingDef.description: A conjured turret of runes and brass.

ThingDef.label: iron sentry focus
ThingDef.description: The focusing crystal of a conjured construct.

ThingDef.label: arc pylon focus
ThingDef.description: The focusing crystal of a conjured construct.

ThingDef.label: arc pylon
ThingDef.description: A pylon crackling with chained lightning.

ThingDef.label: rune colossus focus
ThingDef.description: The focusing crystal of a conjured construct.

ThingDef.label: rune colossus
ThingDef.description: A towering artillery construct. Each shell detonates in a blast of runic fire.

ThingDef.label: runic wall
ThingDef.description: A wall of interlocking runic plates.
